broker.name: Titan FX
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2014. Its site names VFSC, FSC (Mauritius), and FSC (BVI). Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:2000.
broker.about: Titan FX says it has operated since 2014. An address it publishes is Port Vila, Vanuatu. Account names on its site include Zero Standard, Zero Blade, and Zero Micro. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, and Titan FX Social. The site names these regulators: VFSC, FSC (Mauritius), and FSC (BVI). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:2000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. VFSC: Titan FX Limited. FSC (Mauritius): Titan Markets. FSC (BVI): Atlantic Markets Limited.

plans.name: Zero Standard
plans.billing_note: $0 commission per trade. Institutional grade STP spreads. Trade from 0.01 lots. Leverage up to 1000:1. Base currencies USD, EUR, JPY, SGD.

plans.name: Zero Blade
plans.billing_note: USD 3.5 commission per 100k traded. Raw ECN spreads from 0.0 pips. Trade from 0.01 lots. Leverage up to 1000:1.

plans.name: Zero Micro
plans.billing_note: $0 commission per trade. Trade from 0.01 micro lots (page also says 0.1 micro lots or 100 units). Leverage up to 2000:1.

broker.costs_note: Spreads and commissions move with the market, and they are not the same at every company in the group.

leverage.note: Homepage also shows a separate line, Pure 1000:1 leverage.
Homepage headline also shows 2000:1 max leverage.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Zero Micro account page says no minimum initial deposit. Funding methods have their own minimums, so there is not one account minimum. Examples from the funding page: Apple Pay 1 USD, Peska 5 USD, Skrill and Neteller 10 USD, Sticpay 30 USD, international bank transfer 50 USD, local Japanese bank transfer 5,000 JPY.

other_fees.label: Account opening and maintenance
other_fees.note: Accounts page: no account opening or maintenance fees on any trading account.

other_fees.label: Card, e-wallet and bank deposit fees charged by Titan FX
other_fees.value: No deposit fee on the listed methods
other_fees.note: Funding page says international bank transaction fees, Japanese bank fees, and crypto network fees may still apply.

other_fees.label: Withdrawal fee if no trades
other_fees.note: Withdrawal page lists the listed methods as Free, with a 4% withdrawal fee if no trades are made on the account.

_notes.fetch_notes: Company profile says Titan FX was created in 2014 and that the leadership team is based in Port Vila. Compliance page names three licensed entities but does not print a separate licence number. Homepage says 10 trading platforms; the accounts and profile pages name MT4, MT5, mobile apps and Titan FX Social, not all 10. A search extract of a Seychelles financial services guide PDF mentioned a 2022 Seychelles expansion. That PDF was not fetched, so no Seychelles regulator is listed. Zero Micro lot wording on the accounts page is inconsistent (0.01 micro lots and 0.1 micro lots).
